comment: Every feature this fork carries over pingdotgg/t3code. scripts/check-fork-features.ts fails when a listed file or test file is gone, then runs the listed tests. .github/workflows/fork-update.yml runs it in the gate, so an upstream merge that deletes a fork seam stops before it can publish. See docs/operations/fork-windows-build.md.

features.name: fork-app-identity
features.description: The fork installs and runs beside official T3 Code: its own app id, product name, state directory (~/.t3-fork) and t3code-fork:// URL scheme. Issues #34 and #59.

features.name: fork-desktop-build
features.description: The desktop build stages the fork's app id, product name and installer file name, and reads its update source from T3CODE_DESKTOP_UPDATE_REPOSITORY. scripts/release-smoke.ts also carries the fork's fix for running the release-only shell steps under Git for Windows bash. Issues #59, #75 and #94.

features.name: windows-console-suppression
features.description: Spawned server and provider processes no longer draw a console window on Windows. Issue #82.

features.name: terminal-subprocess-poll
features.description: Bounded terminal and preview polling, so Windows stops spawning one PowerShell per terminal per second at unbounded concurrency. Issue #83, merged to main in #106. pollLoop.ts is the fork's own module and upstream has no file at that path, so its test cannot pass on plain upstream.

features.name: fm-acp-provider
features.description: First Mate is driven through its ACP door as a configurable ACP agent provider. Issues #78 and #79.

features.name: fm-worker-threads
features.description: First Mate workers show up as read-only threads, with the fork's own migration track behind them. Issue #81.
